title: Rizzstack bounded recovery protocol (rizzstack.recovery/1)
description: Two durable documents for one classified failure. A REQUEST is written by the orchestrator (bundlebees) from recorded evidence: which task and attempt failed, in which of the five failure classes, and what the approved envelope allows. A DECISION is written by an agent adapter: retry, supersede the frozen contract once, or escalate. The request is mechanical and agent-agnostic; the decision is reasoning and is validated mechanically by bundlebees before anything is dispatched. Neither document grants authority: the envelope restates an authorization that already exists, and a decision can only use what the envelope allows.
$comment: A request is sealed by request_digest: sha256 over json.dumps(request, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True) without request_digest. The request has no volatile field. A decision carries no digest of its own: it binds the exact request bytes through request_digest, which must equal both the request's field and a recomputation from the request body. tools/recovery.py implements the digests, the semantic validator and the CLI.

test_id.description: A test path, optionally with a node id after '::'. The same pattern the RETURN manifest uses for acceptance tests.

failure_class.description: implementation: the patch did not satisfy the approved tests. specification: the acceptance selection itself is unusable, so no patch can satisfy it. environment: the worker host lacked a tool, dependency or route. infrastructure: the launcher, scheduler or storage failed. integration: verified patches did not combine.

failure_code.description: Shape only. tools/recovery.py refuses a code that does not belong to the request's failure class, and refuses a specification request whose code is not an unusable-acceptance code (acceptance_uncovered, test_not_found, missing_test).

kind.description: The recorded artefact's kind. The class decides which kinds are required and which are forbidden: an integration failure needs a conflict record and no other class may carry one.

reference.description: Path or durable reference to the recorded evidence. A reference is not a copy: the record it names stays authoritative.

sha256.description: Optional content hash of the referenced record, when the producer recorded one.

paths.description: For a conflict record: the paths that conflicted. Required on kind conflict and refused on every other kind, enforced by tools/recovery.py so the refusal names the rule.

evidence.description: At least one recorded artefact. A classified failure with no evidence is not a recovery request; it is a claim.

rationale.description: Why this evidence supports this class and code, in the requester's words. Reasoning lives in the decision; the request states what was observed.

sha256.description: The reviewed hash of the frozen acdd/1 contract the failed attempt ran under. A supersession must name this exact pair as the contract it replaces.

max_attempts_per_task.description: Total attempts allowed for this task, counting the attempt that failed. A retry or a supersede needs a remaining attempt; v1 caps the envelope at five total attempts regardless of a larger authorization.

contract_corrections_allowed.description: Contract revisions this task may consume. v1 allows exactly one specification supersession, so the maximum is 1.

corrected_tests_allowed.description: The only tests a decision may add to or substitute in the acceptance selection. Empty when no correction is permitted. A decision cannot widen this list.

schema.description: Protocol version. Shape only: tools/recovery.py refuses any version outside rizzstack.recovery/1.

request_id.description: Stable identity of this request. A decision names it, and a RETURN manifest's recovery entry names it.

attempt_id.description: The attempt whose failure is being recovered. The attempt record is preserved; a recovery never rewrites it.

supersession_permitted.description: true only for a specification failure whose corrected acceptance selection was pre-authorized in corrected_tests_allowed. false for every other class: a retry may not rewrite the contract.

outstanding_question.description: The question the decision answers, stated before any agent reasons about it. It keeps the decision bounded to the failure.

request_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical request without request_digest. tools/recovery.py:seal_request recomputes it and validate_request refuses a mismatch.

contract_id.description: The contract being replaced. It must equal the request's contract.id.

contract_sha256.description: The replaced contract's reviewed hash. It must equal the request's contract.sha256.

new_contract_id.description: The corrected contract. It must equal contract_id: a correction revises the same contract. A different id is a new feature, not a recovery.

new_contract_sha256.description: The corrected contract's reviewed hash. It must differ from contract_sha256; an unchanged contract is not a supersession.

schema.description: Protocol version. Shape only: tools/recovery.py refuses any version outside rizzstack.recovery/1.

request_digest.description: The binding: it must equal the request's request_digest and a recomputation from the request body, so a decision cannot be replayed against a different request.

adapter.description: The agent adapter that reasoned. Agent-agnostic: any adapter name is accepted, except the reserved mechanical components (bundlebees, reconciler, validator), which do not decide.

corrected_tests.description: The corrected acceptance tests. Required and non-empty for supersede, where every entry must be inside corrected_tests_allowed. For an integration repair it may name the added regression test, again inside the allowed list. Empty for an implementation retry and for escalate.

rationale.description: Why this decision answers the outstanding question and stays inside the envelope.

decided_at.description: When the adapter decided. A historical record inside the decision; it is not a request field, so the request digest stays stable.
